sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.ago.day: {n, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
sentry.emptyDesc: Nothing matches these filters. Try a longer period or another status.
sentry.failed: The issues could not be read
sentry.pick: Pick an issue to read it
sentry.setup.title: Connect Sentry
sentry.setup.desc: Add your Sentry organization and a token in Settings. The token stays in your Keychain; the app only reads issues, and changes one only when you click.
sentry.detail.failed: The issue could not be read
sentry.noEvent: The newest event of this issue could not be read.
sentry.linkedRuns: {n, plural, one {# agent run was started from this issue} other {# agent runs were started from this issue}}
sentry.fix.notAssigned: The issue was not assigned to you
sentry.fix.noDialog: The New run dialog could not be opened
sentry.done.title: The agent finished the fix for {id}
sentry.done.desc: Read its changes, then mark the issue as resolved when the fix is in.
sentry.problem.unauthorized: Sentry did not accept the token. Add a new one in Settings.
sentry.problem.forbidden: The token is not allowed to do that. {message}
sentry.problem.notConfigured: Add a Sentry token and organization in Settings first.
sentry.problem.notFound: Sentry has no such organization, project or issue. Check the organization name in Settings.
sentry.problem.rateLimited: Sentry asks for a pause between requests. Try again in a moment.
sentry.problem.rateLimitedIn: Sentry asks for a pause between requests. Try again in {s} seconds.
sentry.problem.testJail: The test jail does not reach the network.
sentry.section.title: Sentry
sentry.section.desc: Read your Sentry issues here and hand one to an agent. The app only reads, and assigns or resolves an issue when you click.
sentry.section.baseDesc: https://sentry.io, or the address of your own Sentry server.
sentry.section.orgDesc: The short name in your Sentry address.
sentry.section.hasToken: A token is saved in your Keychain.
sentry.section.tokenDropped: The address changed, so the saved token was removed: a token only works for the Sentry it was made in. Enter it again.
sentry.section.scopes: A personal token with the scopes org:read, project:read, event:read, event:write and member:read.
sentry.section.notPerson: This token is not a person's: issues can be read, but not assigned to you.
